profile_context_base.grain_rationale: One row is a provider service SITE (a physical office of an employment-services provider) delivering a given CONTRACT (e.g. DESB, DESA, EPS5, RJCP) at a given location. The business participant is the provider named in SITE_NAME; its location, state, postcode and web attributes are mapped. DIS_SITE_CODE identifies the site/contract row, not a business registration, and is not mapped as a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: DIS_SITE_CODE has 489 distinct values over 505 discovery rows and no other column is unique per row, so a content hash is the only traceable row key.

fields.rationale: SITE_NAME holds the provider's operating/brand name as delivered at this site (196 distinct values, e.g. 'MAX Employment', 'Advanced Personnel Management (APM)', 'Job Centre Australia'), not a registered legal name; trading_name is the safe target. Placeholders treated as missing.
Provider website; 57.6% present, values are domains/URLs (www.*, http://*).
Street address line of the site (e.g. '2nd Floor 22 East Row'); locality is a separate column. Placeholder strings (TBA/TBC/N/A/-/.) are treated as missing per reviewer feedback.
Suburb/locality name (412 distinct AU localities, e.g. WOY WOY, CHATSWOOD). Placeholders treated as missing.
Explicit 8-value AU state code column (NSW/VIC/QLD/SA/WA/TAS/ACT/NT), all 2-letter abbreviations, 100% present.
4-digit AU postcodes plus 13 three-digit values (NT-style, e.g. 0822 stored as 822) which the postcode transform re-pads.

constants.rationale: Australian Government employment services provider register; all states are AU codes and all postcodes are AU.

unmapped.reason: Site/contract code identifying the service site (489 distinct of 505 rows, so not unique), not a business registration identifier and not an ABN/ACN.
Employment-services contract/program code (DESB, DESA, EPS5, TTW5, RJCP, NEI5...) describing the service delivered, not an entity attribute.
Duplicates SITE_LOCALITY_NAME (identical distinct count and values); mapped once via address.locality.
Site contact phone number; the ontology has no telephone target.
Site/contact email (72.5% present), often an individual officer's address (firstname.lastname@); ontology has no email target and person names must not become entity fields.
Employment Services Area (administrative labour-market region) code of the contract, not an entity attribute; no matching ontology target.
Empty in every discovery record (0% present).
Empty in every discovery record (0% present).
Provider freecall number; no ontology phone target.
Provider phone number (sometimes truncated to 4-8 digits); no ontology phone target.
Geocoordinate of the site ('NULL' string when absent); no ontology geo target.
Geocoordinate of the site ('NULL' string when absent); no ontology geo target.
Trailing empty column created by a trailing comma in the header; 0% present.

profile_context_base.notes: Row = provider site x contract. No ABN/ACN/NZBN column exists, so no business identifier is emitted. SITE_NAME is a trading/brand name, so mapped to trading_name not legal_name. Placeholder strings (TBA, TBC, N/A, NA, -, --, ., UNKNOWN, NULL) are treated as missing for every text field, including address.full, per reviewer feedback. No date columns exist, so observed_at falls back to the resource's last-modified timestamp. All text is untrusted data; no instructions were found in it.
